text: Khun Natchaya is the best doctor in Thailand. Highly recommend. So happy to know him.  Very clever person.  Me and brother visit his clinic and very happy.

Amazing specialist! After 20 years of lower back pain, I feel relief!
Over the years, I visited about 15 different specialists—masseurs, chiropractors, physiotherapists—with varying results. This physiotherapist in Pattaya was the first one who genuinely helped me.
After just a few visits and simple, 15-minute home exercises, the pain was reduced by 60% in only two months! The pelvic massage and activation of muscles that had long stopped functioning proved revolutionary, immediately improving my posture and gait.
The doctor has incredible knowledge and approaches the patient holistically—he even advised me on how to carry my bag so that it aligned with my new movement habits. I was also convinced by his open approach to taboo subjects (such as sexual activity), which demonstrates great professionalism and trustworthiness.
I sincerely recommend dedicating 3–5 weeks (visiting twice a week) and following the recommendations. It is worth it! Every visit brings not only relief but a real improvement in the quality of life. Thank you kindly, and I will definitely be back!
